correctness.rationale: For the exact positive Crowley–Martin vector field, the prey nullcline y=g(x) from (3-x)(1+x) is maximized uniquely at x=1,y=2, a true coexistence fixed point. Independently differentiated the full rational field at (1,2), obtaining J=[[0,-1/2],[1,-1/2]] and A_h=I+hJ, |lambda(h)|²=1-h/2+h²/2, with unit-circle crossing h=1 and radial derivative +1/4. At h=1 lambda=(3+i sqrt7)/4 has no orders 1..4 resonance. Independently differentiated all quadratic and cubic tensors, constructed normalized left/right eigenvectors q=(1,(1-i sqrt7)/2), p* q=1, and evaluated the full Neimark–Sacker formula: G=-7/20+i sqrt7/140 and Re(conj(lambda)G)=-1/4. Standard local NS theorem gives attracting invariant circle for h>1 near 1 with radius sqrt(h-1)+O(h-1), a local positive-quadrant curve. No claim of global Euler positivity or globally attracting dynamics.
